title: Have a state convert HP damage recieved to MP damage?

posts.author: blablabusby
posts.body:
Hello! I hope I'm not being a bother, but for a while now, I've wanted to figure out a way to have a State wherein a percentage of HP damage recieved is instead converted into MP damage. Think a backported version of Omori's Sad state, wherein damage recieved is partly / fully dealt to Juice/MP instead. I've experimented using various scripts to this end, such as Yanfly's
Convert Damage
and Alistair's
Mana Shield
, but to no avail, either due to my own misunderstanding of the scripts, or them not being designed for such a purpose. I was hoping to see if it were possible to backport this mechanic to VX Ace. Thank you! Forgive me if this is a silly question.
I've included an example of it's implementation in Omori, in RPG Maker MV, if only for comparison. I was briefly wondering if it would be similarly possible to implement such a feature through the use of Yanfly's Lunatic scripts, but I'm afraid I wouldn't know how to.
